e.title: SIIA（美国自保协会）：自保、止损超额保险、专属保险与第三方管理人生态
e.title_en: SIIA (Self-Insurance Institute of America): the ecosystem of self-insurance, stop-loss excess insurance, captive insurance and third-party administrators
e.title_hk: SIIA（美國自保協會）：自保、止損超額保險、專屬保險與第三方管理人生態
e.summary: 美国自保市场协会（1981 年至今）：服务自保付款方、专属保险公司与第三方管理人（TPA），设自保、止损超额保险、专属保险与自保团体健康计划等板块，并同时收录在岸与离岸专属保险辖区信息
e.summary_en: The US self-insurance market association (since 1981): it serves self-insured payers, captives and third-party administrators (TPAs), covers self-insurance, stop-loss excess insurance, captive insurance and self-insured group health plans, and carries information on both onshore and offshore captive domiciles
e.summary_hk: 美國自保市場協會（1981 年至今）：服務自保付款方、專屬保險公司與第三方管理人（TPA），設自保、止損超額保險、專屬保險與自保團體健康計劃等板塊，並同時收錄在岸與離岸專屬保險轄區資訊
e.body:
**SIIA（Self-Insurance Institute of America，美国自保协会）** 是**美国自保（self-insurance）市场的行业协会**（站点标题实测 **「Home | Self-Insurance Institute of America, Inc.」**）。本条目补的是**「自保与第三方管理人（TPA）」这一整块形态**——**实测池内 `third-party administrator` 为 0、`self-insurance` 为 0**（**池内 `tpa` 的 4 条命中经复核全为假阳性：`tpa-transparency-data` 是美国医疗价格透明数据，与 TPA 无关**）。

可核实信息（**均 HTTP 200 实测**）：**站点首页 59.9KB**，正文逐字实测 **「THIS is where the business of self-insurance gets done」** 与 **「As the largest and most-respected association in the self-insurance marketplace, the Self-Insurance Institute of America (SIIA) brings together industry experts, thought leaders, innovative solution providers and the next generation of leaders to ensure that self-insurance remains a sustainable alternative for employers」**；⭐⭐ **并逐字实测其服务范围（含 TPA）**：**「Since 1981, SIIA has been committed to providing self-insured payers, captives, TPA’s and the partners that support them with advocacy on Capitol Hill, timely education on industry tre[nds]」**——**即该协会明确服务「自保付款方、专属保险公司、第三方管理人（TPA）及其支持伙伴」**；⭐ **「About SIIA」页实测 35.8KB**；⭐ **「About Self-Insurance」页实测 36.2KB，标题「About Self-Insurance | Self-Insurance Institute of America, Inc.」**；⭐ **「Captive Insurance」页实测 35.5KB**。**导航与链接逐字实测揭示的结构**（⭐ **该站点的 URL 为不透明参数形式 `/i4a/pages/index.cfm?pageid=NNNN`，本词条所述页面均系由锚文本映射后逐一实测标题确认**）：**About** 下含 **About Self-Insurance**、⭐ **Stop-Loss Excess Insurance（止损超额保险）**、**Captive Insurance**、⭐ **Understanding Captive Insurance**、⭐ **Onshore Captive Domicile Information（在岸专属保险辖区信息）**、⭐ **Offshore Captive Domicile Information（离岸专属保险辖区信息）**、⭐ **Self-Insured Group Health Plans（自保团体健康计划）**、⭐ **Glossary of Self-Insurance Terms（自保术语表）**、⭐ **Captive Resource Center**；**Advocacy** 下含 **Advocacy in Action Resource Center** 与 **Self-Insurance Political Action Committee**；⭐ **Self-Insurance Marketplace Directory（自保市场名录）** 实测 80.3KB；**The Self-Insurer Magazine（会刊）**；**会员分档实测**为 **Diamond Members / 2026 Gold Members / 2026 Silver Members / Members Only / Welcome New Members**；另有 **2026 Event Schedule** 与 **Career Hub**。

对 RIAA：**① 补上「自保」与「第三方管理人（TPA）」这两个此前完全空白的形态**——**自保（企业自行承担风险、以止损超额保险兜底）是商业保险之外的一条主要风险融资路径**，**而 TPA 是替企业或保险公司承担理赔与行政职能的第三方**；**两者此前在池内都没有入口**（**可与池内 [[mib]]（英国车险的行业级理赔机制）、[[clm]]（理赔专业组织）、[[cila]]（公估师）并读——**那三条都在「理赔由谁做」这一层，但都不涉及「企业自保」这一风险融资安排**）。**② ⭐⭐ 「同时收录在岸与离岸专属保险辖区信息」是本轮最重要的结构发现之一**——**SIIA 把 Onshore 与 Offshore 两类辖区并列收录**，**即协会在辖区选择上保持**信息中性****；**这与同轮 [[cica]] 自称「住所中立（Domicile-Neutral）」、以及同轮两个辖区（[[bma]] 离岸、[[vermont-captive]] 在岸）各自主动招揽形成完整对照**（**本次未打开任何辖区页面，故不转述其具体内容或推荐立场**）。**③ ⭐ 「止损超额保险（Stop-Loss Excess Insurance）」是自保安排的关键配套险种**——**企业自保后需以止损保单封顶自身风险**，**这解释了「自保不是不买保险，而是换一种买法」**；**对做企业风险融资的学生，这是一个清晰的产品—制度配套样本**（**本次未打开该页，故不转述其承保方式或触发机制**）。**④ 「自保术语表」与「自保市场名录」是两份实用资产**——**前者是术语入口、后者是服务提供者入口**（**本次均未打开，故不主张名录的规模或构成**）。**⑤ URL 形态值得记一笔**：**该站点大量页面使用 `pageid=NNNN` 这类不透明参数**——**对做网络资源编目的学生，这提示「同一站点的页面无法从 URL 推断内容，必须靠锚文本或站内检索」**（**本词条正是这样做的**）。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次核实到**首页与四个页面的存在、标题、页面体量、两处关键正文逐字表述、以及导航与链接逐字实测的完整板块结构**，**但未打开任何内容页正文、未打开在岸/离岸辖区页、术语表、市场名录、Captive Resource Center、会刊或倡导资源中心**，因此**不能转述任何自保机制细节、TPA 的职能与监管安排、辖区信息内容、名录成员或术语定义**；**② ⭐ 「服务 TPA」为**首页正文逐字实测**（**引文在实测处以「industry tre…」截断，词条内只引用到该处为止**）；**但该协会对 TPA 的具体服务形式、会员中 TPA 的占比本次未核实**；**③ 「TPA」与「第三方管理人」的中文译法**（亦见「第三方管理机构」）**本次未核实其通行度**，**词条内保留英文缩写并给出中文对译**；**④ 「1981 年至今」与「largest and most-respected」均为**站点自述**，**已在词条内如此标注，不作独立核实或评价**；**⑤ 该协会的会员规模、法定地位与资金来源本次未核实**；**⑥ 是否有中文材料本次未核实**；**⑦** 本词条**不主张** SIIA 提供精算工具、定价模型或可下载数据**。**核实说明**：首页（59.9KB）、`/about/`（35.8KB）、`pageid=7439`（36.2KB）、`pageid=7022`（35.5KB）、`pageid=7024`（40.7KB）、`pageid=8121`（80.3KB）均经**缓冲区安全探活工具 `discovery/probe-urls.sh`** HTTP 200 实测并逐字读取标题与正文；**未打开任何内容页正文**。
e.body_en:
**SIIA (the Self-Insurance Institute of America)** is **the trade association for the US self-insurance market** (measured site title **"Home | Self-Insurance Institute of America, Inc."**). This entry adds the entire **"self-insurance and third-party administrators (TPAs)"** form — **measured: `third-party administrator` returned zero and `self-insurance` returned zero** (**the four `tpa` hits in the corpus were reviewed and are all false positives: `tpa-transparency-data` is US healthcare price-transparency data, unrelated to TPAs**).

Verifiable details (**all measured HTTP 200**): the **homepage is 59.9KB**, its body stating verbatim **"THIS is where the business of self-insurance gets done"** and **"As the largest and most-respected association in the self-insurance marketplace, the Self-Insurance Institute of America (SIIA) brings together industry experts, thought leaders, innovative solution providers and the next generation of leaders to ensure that self-insurance remains a sustainable alternative for employers"**; ⭐⭐ **and stating its service scope verbatim, including TPAs**: **"Since 1981, SIIA has been committed to providing self-insured payers, captives, TPA’s and the partners that support them with advocacy on Capitol Hill, timely education on industry tre[nds]"** — **i.e. the association explicitly serves self-insured payers, captives, third-party administrators and their supporting partners**; ⭐ the **"About SIIA" page measures 35.8KB**; ⭐ the **"About Self-Insurance" page measures 36.2KB**; ⭐ the **"Captive Insurance" page measures 35.5KB**. **Structure read verbatim from navigation and links** (⭐ **the site uses opaque parameter URLs of the form `/i4a/pages/index.cfm?pageid=NNNN`; every page described here was mapped from anchor text and then verified by measuring its title**): under **About** — **About Self-Insurance**, ⭐ **Stop-Loss Excess Insurance**, **Captive Insurance**, ⭐ **Understanding Captive Insurance**, ⭐ **Onshore Captive Domicile Information**, ⭐ **Offshore Captive Domicile Information**, ⭐ **Self-Insured Group Health Plans**, ⭐ **Glossary of Self-Insurance Terms** and ⭐ **Captive Resource Center**; under **Advocacy** — an **Advocacy in Action Resource Center** and a **Self-Insurance Political Action Committee**; ⭐ a **Self-Insurance Marketplace Directory** measuring 80.3KB; **The Self-Insurer Magazine**; **measured membership tiers** — **Diamond Members, 2026 Gold Members, 2026 Silver Members, Members Only and Welcome New Members**; plus a **2026 Event Schedule** and a **Career Hub**.

For RIAA: **① it adds "self-insurance" and "third-party administrators (TPAs)", both entirely absent** — **self-insurance (a company retaining risk and capping it with stop-loss cover) is a major alternative risk-financing route alongside commercial insurance**, **and a TPA is a third party performing claims and administrative functions for employers or insurers**; **neither had an entry point before** (**readable with [[mib]] (the UK motor industry claims mechanism), [[clm]] (a claims professional body) and [[cila]] (loss adjusters) — those three all sit in the "who does claims" layer but none touches corporate self-insurance as a risk-financing arrangement**). **② ⭐⭐ Carrying both onshore and offshore captive domicile information is one of the round’s most important structural findings** — **SIIA lists onshore and offshore domiciles side by side**, **i.e. the association keeps an information-neutral stance on domicile choice**; **this forms a complete contrast with [[cica]]’s self-description as "domicile-neutral" and with the two domiciles in the same round actively soliciting business ([[bma]] offshore, [[vermont-captive]] onshore)** (**no domicile page was opened, so neither its content nor any recommendation is restated**). **③ ⭐ Stop-loss excess insurance is the key companion cover to a self-insurance arrangement** — **a company that retains risk must cap its exposure with a stop-loss policy**, **which explains that "self-insurance is not buying less insurance but buying it differently"**; **a clear product-institution pairing for students of corporate risk financing** (**not opened, so no underwriting method or trigger is restated**). **④ The glossary of self-insurance terms and the marketplace directory are two practical assets** — **a terminology entry point and a service-provider entry point** (**neither opened, so no scale or composition is claimed**). **⑤ The URL pattern is worth noting**: **many pages use opaque `pageid=NNNN` parameters** — **for students cataloguing web resources, this shows a site whose page content cannot be inferred from the URL and must be found via anchor text or site search** (**which is exactly what this entry did**).

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this check verified **the homepage and four pages’ existence, titles and sizes, two key verbatim body statements, and the complete section structure read verbatim from navigation and links**, **but opened no content page body, no onshore or offshore domicile page, no glossary, no marketplace directory, no Captive Resource Center, no magazine and no advocacy resource centre**, so **no self-insurance mechanics, TPA function or regulatory arrangement, domicile content, directory member or term definition can be restated**; **② ⭐ "serves TPAs" is read verbatim from the homepage** (**the quotation truncates at "industry tre…" and the entry quotes no further**); **but how the association services TPAs, and what share of members are TPAs, were not verified**; **③ the Chinese rendering of "TPA"** (also seen as 第三方管理机构) **was not verified for currency**, **and the entry keeps the English abbreviation with a Chinese gloss**; **④ "since 1981" and "largest and most-respected" are the site’s own statements**, **labelled as such in the entry with no independent verification or evaluation**; **⑤ the association’s membership size, legal status and funding were not verified**; **⑥ whether Chinese-language material exists was not verified**; **⑦** this entry **does not claim SIIA provides actuarial tools, pricing models or downloadable data**. **Verification note**: the homepage (59.9KB), `/about/` (35.8KB), `pageid=7439` (36.2KB), `pageid=7022` (35.5KB), `pageid=7024` (40.7KB) and `pageid=8121` (80.3KB) were measured at HTTP 200 using the **buffer-safe probe tool `discovery/probe-urls.sh`**, with titles and body read verbatim; **no content page body was opened**.
e.body_hk:
**SIIA（Self-Insurance Institute of America，美國自保協會）** 是**美國自保（self-insurance）市場的行業協會**（站點標題實測 **「Home | Self-Insurance Institute of America, Inc.」**）。本條目補的是**「自保與第三方管理人（TPA）」這一整塊形態**——**實測池內 `third-party administrator` 為 0、`self-insurance` 為 0**（**池內 `tpa` 的 4 條命中經複核全為假陽性**）。

可核實資訊（**均 HTTP 200 實測**）：首頁 **59.9KB**，正文逐字實測 **「THIS is where the business of self-insurance gets done」**；⭐⭐ **並逐字實測其服務範圍（含 TPA）**：**「Since 1981, SIIA has been committed to providing self-insured payers, captives, TPA’s and the partners that support them with advocacy on Capitol Hill, timely education on industry tre…」**；⭐ **「About Self-Insurance」頁 36.2KB**；⭐ **「Captive Insurance」頁 35.5KB**；⭐ **「Self-Insurance Marketplace Directory」頁 80.3KB**。**導航與連結逐字實測**（⭐ 該站 URL 為不透明參數形式 `/i4a/pages/index.cfm?pageid=NNNN`，本詞條所述頁面均由錨文本映射後逐一實測標題確認）：**About** 下含 **About Self-Insurance／⭐Stop-Loss Excess Insurance／Captive Insurance／⭐Understanding Captive Insurance／⭐Onshore Captive Domicile Information／⭐Offshore Captive Domicile Information／⭐Self-Insured Group Health Plans／⭐Glossary of Self-Insurance Terms／⭐Captive Resource Center**；**會員分檔實測**為 **Diamond／2026 Gold／2026 Silver／Members Only／Welcome New Members**。

對 RIAA：**① 補上「自保」與「第三方管理人（TPA）」這兩個此前完全空白的形態**——**自保是商業保險之外的一條主要風險融資路徑，而 TPA 是替企業或保險公司承擔理賠與行政職能的第三方**（可與 [[mib]]、[[clm]]、[[cila]] 並讀——**那三條都在「理賠由誰做」這一層，但都不涉及「企業自保」**）。**② ⭐⭐ 「同時收錄在岸與離岸轄區資訊」是本輪最重要的結構發現之一**——**SIIA 把 Onshore 與 Offshore 並列收錄，即協會在轄區選擇上保持**資訊中性****；**這與同輪 [[cica]] 自稱「住所中立」以及兩個轄區（[[bma]] 離岸、[[vermont-captive]] 在岸）各自主動招攬形成完整對照**。**③ ⭐ 「止損超額保險」是自保安排的关键配套險種**——**企業自保後需以止損保單封頂自身風險**，**這解釋了「自保不是不買保險，而是換一種買法」**。**④ 「自保術語表」與「自保市場名錄」是兩份實用資產**。**⑤ URL 形態值得記一筆**：**大量頁面使用不透明 `pageid=` 參數**——**對做網絡資源編目的學生，這提示「同一站點的頁面無法從 URL 推斷內容」**。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**①** 本次核實到**首頁與四個頁面的存在、標題、體量、兩處關鍵正文、導航逐字實測的完整板塊結構**，**但未打開任何內容頁正文、在岸/離岸轄區頁、術語表、市場名錄、Captive Resource Center、會刊或倡導資源中心**，故**不能轉述任何自保機制、TPA 職能與監管安排、轄區資訊、名錄成員或術語定義**；**② ⭐ 「服務 TPA」為首頁正文逐字實測**（**引文在「industry tre…」處截斷，詞條內即止**）；**但其對 TPA 的具體服務形式與會員中 TPA 佔比未核實**；**③ 「TPA」中文譯法的通行度未核實**；**④ 「1981 年至今」與「largest and most-respected」均為站點自述，已如此標註，不作獨立核實或評價**；**⑤ 會員規模、法定地位與資金來源未核實**；**⑥ 是否有中文材料未核實**；**⑦** 本詞條**不主張** SIIA 提供精算工具、定價模型或可下載數據**。**核實說明**：六個 URL 均經**緩衝區安全探活工具 `discovery/probe-urls.sh`** HTTP 200 實測並逐字讀取標題與正文；**未打開任何內容頁正文**。
